title: APPROVAL OF EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATING AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND PACIFIC CRUISE TERMINALS, LLC
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF EXCLUSIVE NEGOTIATING AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND PACIFIC CRUISE TERMINALS, LLC
Transmittal 1
Summary
: Staff request approval to enter into an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA) with Pacific Cruise Terminals, LLC (PCT) to exclusively negotiate a long-term lease to develop and operate the Los Angeles Cruise Terminal (Project). The Project is located at Berths 90-92 and Berth 93 (Inner Harbor Cruise Terminal) and Berths 45-47 and 49-51 (Outer Harbor Cruise Terminal) (collectively Premises) within the Port of Los Angeles. The proposed ENA contemplates a one-year initial term with two separate six-month options to extend, at the Executive Director’s discretion, for a total term not to exceed two years from the effective date. This ENA is in alignment with the following City of Los Angeles (City) Harbor Department (Harbor Department) Strategic Objectives to include providing: 1) World-Class Infrastructure That Promotes Growth; and 2) Improved Financial Performance of Port Assets. Approval of the proposed ENA will not have a financial impact on the Harbor Department.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve the ENA with Pacific Cruise Terminals, LLC; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the ENA for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. __________________.
Waterfront & Commercial Real Estate
summary: Approval of Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Pacific Cruise Terminals, LLC to develop and operate Los Angeles Cruise Terminal at Port of Los Angeles berths.
